# 🔷 TypeScript Architecture & Type Systems Mastery Track

Welcome to the **TypeScript Architecture & Type Systems Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace covers TypeScript from fundamentals and discriminated unions to advanced type-level metaprogramming (`infer`, mapped types, conditional types, template literal types) and runtime validation.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-tsc-compiler` | Compiler & Config | `tsconfig.json`, `tsc`, `ES2022`, strict flags, AST checking |
| `01-basics-primitive-types` | Type Primitives & Bottom Types | `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `any` vs `unknown` vs `never` |
| `02-literal-types-and-unions` | Discriminated Unions | Type narrowing (`typeof`, `instanceof`, `in`), exhaustiveness checking |
| `03-objects-interfaces-type-aliases` | Object Models | `interface` vs `type`, declaration merging, index signatures, `readonly` |
| `04-tuples-and-enums` | Tuples & Const Assertions | `as const`, labeled tuples, string enums vs union objects |
| `05-functions-and-signatures` | Functions & Overloads | Function overloads, `this` parameter typing, generic call signatures |
| `06-generics-and-constraints` | Generics & Bounds | Generic constraints (`T extends Record<string, unknown>`), generic defaults |
| `07-conditional-types-and-infer` | Conditional Types & `infer` | `T extends U ? X : Y`, unpacking Promises, extracting tuple types with `infer` |
| `08-mapped-types-and-keyof` | Mapped Types & Metaprogramming | `keyof`, `in keyof`, template literal types, modifier removal (`-readonly`, `?`) |
| `09-utility-types-deep-dive` | Standard Utility Types | `Partial`, `Required`, `Pick`, `Omit`, `Record`, `ReturnType`, `Awaited` |
| `10-classes-and-inheritance` | OOP & Access Modifiers | `private` vs `#private` (hard private), abstract classes, parameter properties |
| `11-decorators-and-metadata` | TC39 Decorators | Class decorators, method decorators, accessor decorators, metadata reflection |
| `12-modules-namespaces-and-paths` | ESM & Type Imports | `import type`, re-exports, path mapping (`baseUrl`, `paths`) |
| `13-error-handling-and-custom-errors` | Error Architecture | Discriminated `Result<T, E>` types, safe narrowing of `catch (err: unknown)` |
| `14-async-promises-and-event-loop` | Async & Event Loop | `Promise<T>`, microtask vs macrotask queue, `Promise.allSettled` |
| `15-schema-validation-with-zod` | Runtime Schema Validation | Zod schema parsing, `z.infer<typeof schema>`, transforms, custom refinements |
| `16-testing-with-vitest` | Testing & Type Assertions | Unit testing, type-level assertions (`expectTypeOf`), test runners |
| `17-monorepos-and-project-references` | Project References | Composite projects, `tsBuildInfo`, workspace resolution |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 TypeScript gotchas (bivariance, structural typing, `never` checks) |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `example.ts` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.ts` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.ts` — Complete reference solution.

```ts
export const LogLevel = {
  Info: "INFO",
  Warn: "WARN",
  Error: "ERROR",
} as const;

export type LogLevel = (typeof LogLevel)[keyof typeof LogLevel];
```

## 🎯 `Promise.allSettled` vs `Promise.all`
- `Promise.all`: Short-circuits immediately if any promise rejects.
- `Promise.allSettled`: Waits for all promises to resolve or reject, returning `{ status: 'fulfilled' | 'rejected' }`.

## 🎯 Bridging Static Types & Runtime Data
TypeScript types vanish at runtime. Zod validates untrusted external payloads and infers static TypeScript types automatically:
```ts
const UserSchema = z.object({ id: z.number(), email: z.string().email() });
type User = z.infer<typeof UserSchema>;
```
